ret = {}
    for device in __salt__["raid.list_devices"]():
        ret[device] = {}
        for partition in __salt__["raid.list_partitions"](device):
            ret[device][partition] = {}
            for array in __salt__["raid.list_arrays"](device, partition):
                ret[device][partition][array] = {}
                for member in __salt__["raid.list_members"](device, partition, array):
                    ret[device][partition][array][member] = {}
                    for property_ in __salt__["raid.list_properties"](
                        device, partition, array, member
                    ):
                        ret[device][partition][array][member][property_] = (
                            __salt__["raid.get_property"](
                                device, partition, array, member, property_
                            )
                        )
    return ret


def create(
    device,
    partition,
    array,
    level,
    members,
    metadata=None,
    spares=None,
    chunk_size=None,
    name=None,
    **kwargs
):
    """
    Create a RAID array.

    device
        The device to create the array on.

    partition
        The partition to create the array on.

    array
        The name of the array to create.

    level
        The RAID level to create.

    members
        A list of devices to use as members.

    metadata
        The metadata format to use.

    spares
        A list of devices to use as spares.

    chunk_size
        The chunk size to use.

    name
        The name of the array to create.

    kwargs
        Any additional arguments to pass to the raid.create command.

    CLI Example:

    .. code-block:: bash

        salt '*' raid.create /dev/md0 /dev/sda1
